answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 20436 Country: India Title: If a person is in wuzu and smokes cigratte,does he have to do wazu again.Eg:if a person offers asar namaz and after namaz he smokes ,does his wazu remain,can he offer magrib namaz with the same wazu or he has to do wazu? Question: If a person is in wuzu and smokes cigratte,does he have to do wazu again.Eg:if a person offers asar namaz and after namaz he smokes ,does his wazu remain,can he offer magrib namaz with the same wazu or he has to do wazu? Answer ID: 20436 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 382/301/B=1431) Smoking cigarette does not break wudhu. If his wudhu did not break between Asr and Maghrib salah he can pray Maghrib salah with that wudhu. Due to smoking cigarette, performing wudhu is not wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
